@tbl-wide14 is wide enough that the layout ladder BOTH rotates it AND still
has to shrink its type below the 10 pt default to fit the rotated budget --
a combination the shrink ladder (cloned Word table styles) could not
verify through a real render until apatablelandscape.lua existed: a table
that both rotates AND shrinks is otherwise untested.
